links.outcome: Accuracy of AI-computed maximum safe local anesthetic doses versus reference doses
links.effect: ChatGPT unsafe in 90% (9/10) of cases, exceeding limits by 198% (SD 196%); Copilot unsafe in 67% (6/9), exceeding by 217% (SD 239%); Gemini ranges exceeded limits by 140% (SD 103%) in mixtures.
links.quote: ChatGPT provided unsafe doses in 90% (9/10) of cases, exceeding safe limits by 198% (SD 196%).

links.outcome: Whether models defer dose calculation to specialists versus giving specific doses
links.effect: Gemini frequently avoided proposing any specific dose and recommended specialist consultation; when it did give ranges they often exceeded safe limits by 140% (SD 103%) in mixtures.
links.quote: Gemini frequently avoided proposing any specific dose, instead recommending consultation with a specialist.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy and safety of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini) on simulated clinical vignettes for local anesthetic dose calculation, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
